edits.after:
#define TRACE_MMAP_LOCK_EVENT(type, mm, ...)                                   \
	do {                                                                   \
		const char *memcg_path;                                        \
		char local_buf[MEMCG_PATH_BUF_SIZE];                           \
		local_lock(&memcg_paths.lock);                                 \
		memcg_path = get_mm_memcg_path(mm);                            \
		if (memcg_path != NULL) {                                      \
			strscpy(local_buf, memcg_path, MEMCG_PATH_BUF_SIZE);   \
			put_memcg_path_buf();                                  \
		}                                                              \
		local_unlock(&memcg_paths.lock);                               \
		trace_mmap_lock_##type(mm,                                     \
				       memcg_path != NULL ? local_buf : "",    \
				       ##__VA_ARGS__);                         \
	} while (0)
